description.narrative: By 2030, institutional primary health-care capacities at national and subnational levels are enhanced to provide inclusive, responsive, equitable and quality immunization and health emergency services in underserved/zero dose communities and humanitarian settings. Over 203,215 zero-dose and 211,659 under-vaccinated children were immunized; cold chain coverage rose from 67% to 80%; last-mile delivery reached 165 conflict-affected woredas; and access to life-saving health services increased from 2-million to 3.5-million people
